concerns.text: SC-001 lacks a concrete, measurable threshold. It states “statistical power and effect size stability … are measured against the total number of migratory species” but does not specify what power level or effect‑size stability metric is required (e.g., power ≥ 0.8, coefficient CV ≤ 0.2). Without a numeric target the criterion cannot be evaluated.

SC-005 references “the CI runner time limit defined in Assumptions” but the Assumptions section never states a concrete time limit. The success criterion therefore has no observable reference point and cannot be verified.

FR-006 mentions “represent weekly migration centroids as trajectories on a Riemannian manifold and apply manifold‑based trajectory statistics” but does not specify which algorithm or library will be used, nor what output format constitutes a “shift vector”. Adding a brief description (e.g., “use the Geodesic PCA implementation from the ‘geomstats’ library, outputting a 3‑component vector in km and bearing”) would make the requirement directly testable.
